title: Introducing the Museum of Delight
author: Maria Popova
summary: After twenty years of making immaterial things with my mind — ideas sculpted of words, questions woven of sentences, translucent vessels for thought and feeling in the shape of poems — I found myself overcome by the urge to make things with my hands out of matter: clay, thread, stone, resin, wood, lichen. They now live in the Museum of Delight.
